facts.fact: Oubangui Médias reports that on 24 October 2025 a Bangui workshop led by the Ministry of Commerce with UNDP validated the specification for digitising the manual Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier, to be accessed through the one-stop business formalities counter, which has a branch at Bambari with another planned at Berberati.
